## Introduction: SimplePractice Isn't for Everyone

The best SimplePractice alternative depends on your practice model. Private-pay therapists usually need simple scheduling, payments, notes, assessments, and client communication without insurance-heavy complexity. This guide compares six alternatives by pricing, processing fees, AI notes, telehealth, billing fit, and migration support.

SimplePractice dominates the therapy EHR market with over 225,000 clinicians, but that doesn't make it the right choice for every practice. If you're a private-pay therapist searching for SimplePractice alternatives, you're not alone-and you likely have good reasons.

Common pain points driving the search include a March 2025 pricing restructure, payment processing fees of 3.15% + 30¢ per transaction, insurance-centric features that add complexity for cash-based practices, and AI documentation tools that fall short of newer purpose-built solutions.
